boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Missouri University of Science and Technology
boards.description: Ten Rolla food stops with published evening or overnight availability, suitable for under-21 visitors.

cards.title: Taco Bell on N Bishop
cards.subtitle: 1109 N Bishop Avenue, Rolla
cards.notes: Use the dining room before midnight or the drive-thru later; confirm holiday changes before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A Rolla Taco Bell with overnight drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists drive-thru service until 4 AM Sunday–Thursday and 5 AM Friday–Saturday; dine-in is listed until midnight.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: 9 AM–4 AM Sunday–Thursday and 9 AM–5 AM Friday–Saturday. Dine-in is listed until midnight; hours can vary.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Highway 72
cards.subtitle: 120 Highway 72 West, Rolla
cards.notes: Plan for drive-thru service after the dining room closes, and check the official locator for holiday-hour updates.
cards.short_summary: A second Rolla Taco Bell with 3 AM drive-thru availability.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists drive-thru hours from 9 AM to 3 AM daily and dine-in hours until 11 PM.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed 9 AM–3 AM daily; dine-in is listed until 11 PM. Confirm hours before travel.

cards.title: Wendy’s on Kings Highway
cards.subtitle: 1007 Kings Highway, Rolla
cards.notes: Choose counter service or drive-thru before 2 AM; verify holiday hours on the location page before making a late trip.
cards.short_summary: A Kings Highway restaurant listed open daily until 2 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official Rolla location page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 6 AM to 2 AM every day.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are listed 6 AM–2 AM daily. The page notes that holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Pizza Hut Classic on Kings Hwy
cards.subtitle: 1024 Kings Hwy, Rolla
cards.notes: Use dine-in, carryout, or delivery options, with Friday and Saturday listed latest; check the ordering mode before departure.
cards.short_summary: A retro-format Pizza Hut with midnight weekend restaurant hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut’s official Rolla page lists restaurant hours until 11 PM Sunday–Thursday and midnight Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours: 10:30 AM–11 PM Sunday–Thursday; 10:30 AM–midnight Friday–Saturday. Delivery hours may vary.

cards.title: Imo’s Pizza on S Bishop
cards.subtitle: 632 S Bishop Avenue, Rolla
cards.notes: Order for pickup, delivery, or the dining room before the published 10 PM closing time; verify special-day hours first.
cards.short_summary: A S Bishop pizza stop with service listed to 10 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Imo’s official Rolla store page lists hours until 10 PM Monday–Saturday and until 10 PM on Sunday after an 11 AM opening.
cards.access_notes: Listed open to 10 PM daily; Sunday begins at 11 AM. The page also lists delivery through the posted store hours.

cards.title: IHOP on N Bishop
cards.subtitle: 1735 N Bishop Avenue, Rolla
cards.notes: For a later seated meal, target Friday or Saturday before midnight; takeout and online ordering are also listed.
cards.short_summary: A N Bishop diner with midnight Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP’s official Rolla page lists restaurant hours until midnight on Friday and Saturday and until 10 PM Sunday–Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: 6 AM–midnight Friday and Saturday; 6 AM–10 PM Sunday–Thursday. Dine-in and takeout are listed.

cards.title: Freddy’s on N Bishop
cards.subtitle: 2004 N Bishop Avenue, Rolla
cards.notes: Schedule this for Friday or Saturday when the published closing time is 11 PM; the location offers a drive-thru.
cards.short_summary: A N Bishop steakburger and custard stop open to 11 PM on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Freddy’s official Rolla announcement states hours of 10:30 AM–10 PM Sunday–Thursday and 10:30 AM–11 PM Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours are 10:30 AM–10 PM Sunday–Thursday and 10:30 AM–11 PM Friday–Saturday; drive-thru service is stated.

cards.title: Sonic on S Bishop
cards.subtitle: 109 S Bishop Avenue, Rolla
cards.notes: Use the listed drive-in stop through 11 PM most nights or midnight Friday and Saturday; recheck before a late visit.
cards.short_summary: A S Bishop drive-in with midnight weekend availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Sonic’s official Rolla location listing gives hours until 11 PM Sunday–Thursday and midnight Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Sonic Drive-In — 109 S Bishop Avenue, Rolla
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are 6 AM–11 PM Sunday–Thursday and 6 AM–midnight Friday–Saturday. Check for location-specific changes.

cards.title: Denny’s on Martin Springs
cards.subtitle: 1419 Martin Springs Rd., Rolla
cards.notes: Aim to arrive before the posted 10 PM close; the official location page lists walk-ins, takeout, and family-friendly service.
cards.short_summary: A Martin Springs diner listed open nightly until 10 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s official Rolla location page lists restaurant hours of 6 AM to 10 PM every day.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours are listed as 6 AM–10 PM daily; contact the location to confirm hours, as its page advises.

cards.title: Los Arcos
cards.subtitle: Rolla, Missouri
cards.notes: Use the Friday or Saturday evening window, when the restaurant lists a 10 PM close; confirm the day’s hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A Rolla Mexican restaurant with 10 PM Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Los Arcos’ official Rolla website lists hours until 10 PM on Friday and Saturday, with earlier closes on other days.
cards.access_notes: Official hours list 11 AM–10 PM Friday and Saturday; Thursday ends at 9:30 PM, and other days close earlier.
